name: Trusty Shepherds
text: On play, gain 2/2/2/2/2 strength for up to 4 other friendly units on board

name: Demotivating Strike
text: Disable a target unit’s ability, then deal 4/5/6/7/8 damage

name: Restless Goats
text: On death, deal 1/1/2/2/3 damage to your base

name: Devastators
text: Before attacking a structure or base, deal 3/3/4/5/6 additional damage to it

name: Awakening of the Will
text: Give strength to 1/1/2/2/3 random friendly unit/unit/units/units/units with no ability equal to its mana cost, then repeat this effect for up to 1/2/2/4/5 of its mana cost

name: Marked as Prey
text: Deal 6/7/8/9/11 damage to a target poisoned unit. If that kills it, spawn a 6/7/8/9/11 strength Raven there

name: Stream of Consciousness
text: Destroy a target friendly Ancient unit and play an equal or higher cost random level 1/2/3/4/5 non-Ancient unit on the same tile

name: Doppelbocks
text: On play, spawn a 1/1/1-2/2/2 strength Satyr on the tile in front

name: Armed Schemers
text: On play, pull enemy units towards itself. Then deal 3/4/5/6/7 damage to bordering enemy units

name: Wandering Wyrms
text: When played bordering a friendly Dragon, deal 2/3/4/6/8 damage to the strongest enemy unit

name: Prime Oracle Bragda
text: After surviving damage, increase the strength of up to 3/3/4/4/4 weaker friendly units to match her own

name: Erratic Neglects
text: Before moving, get a random status effect

name: Ozone Purifiers
text: On play, push a random bordering enemy unit away

name: Malicious Discard
text: Discard a random card from your hand

name: Spare Dragonling
text: On death, give 3/4/5/6/7 strength to a random friendly Dragon

name: Qordia’s Nest
text: At the start of your turn, hatch and spawn a 1/2/3/4/5 strength Dragon here

name: Melodious Sisters
text: Before attacking a confused unit, deal 4/5/6/7/8 damage to all enemies surrounding it

name: Function Wilds
text: On play, vitalize itself and 1/1/2/2/2 surrounding friendly unit/unit/units/units/units

name: Chateau de Cardboard
text: At the start of your turn, confuse the 1/1/1/1/1 most forward enemy unit/unit/units/units/units

name: Icicle Burst
text: Freeze a target enemy unit. If it is already frozen, deal 6/7/8/10/12 damage to it instead. If target dies, gain 1 mana

name: Mechanical Workers
text: On play, build a 5/5/6/7/8 strength workshop on the tile behind, which spawns 2/3/4/5/6 strength Constructs each turn

name: Glacier Palace
text: At the start of your turn, freeze the most forward enemy unit

name: Lunatic Lunas
text: After surviving damage, force itself to attack the first enemy unit or structure in front

name: Petrified Fossils
text: After surviving damage, command friendly units with equal or less strength forward
